question: Explain what makes a constitution codified rather than merely written.
raw: O1: [S2] A constitution is codified when it is encompassed in a single comprehensive document. This means that all the fundamental principles or established precedents are compiled into one cohesive written document, as opposed to being spread across multiple legal documents or acts.
